uncertainty: Paired theorem repeat averages; bootstrap theorems and ten family clusters; common-verified effort separately; no success-conditioned causal claim.
selection: 48 original Phase 1 development IDs exclusively. Twelve order development IDs for hyperparameter selection; final refit on permitted development. Pilots excluded from training; all Phase 1–4 held-out material diagnosis only.

retrieval.allocation: Protect up to 16 original candidates, goal/specialized first then original stable order; remaining slots for novelty, original backfill. All typed variants share pool/universe/gate/cap except explicit ablations. Learned retrieval selects availability; final scheduling remains separate.

training.pair_labels: Verified-path actions over actually rejected applications; verified-vs-verified unequal fixed-continuation attempt costs. Accepted/censored/unselected are never negatives.
training.objective: Pairwise logistic loss plus L2; pre-execution native and frozen P3 structural features, no theorem IDs/answers/successor features.
training.fallback: If insufficient, learned arms are explicitly unavailable; deterministic remains primary and no fictitious scores.

automation: Aesop/grind external single-call references; ring/omega original specialized actions; group and set simp-only explicit normalizers, separate no_normalize ablation. Native allocation heartbeats are not inference counts.
pilot: Six independent development-only pilots. Original solved 2/6; deterministic typed 4/6, losing logical-choice pilot. Lattice pilot unsolved in both. All ten final families retained; no changes following test execution.
frontier_subset: Frozen Phase 4 joint only: isolates learned queue with P3 action scheduling; selected linear artifact already duplicates linear control; beam changes frontier pruning and is excluded to control matrix size.
freeze: Statements, index, training boundaries, full arms, caps, metrics frozen before model selection. Execution code/model additionally hashed and committed before test runs; no test retuning.
